svg.text: Generated from computed grid coordinates — hole numbers and wire endpoints are exact by construction
✓ ESP32 pin layout below is read directly from a photo of the user's own board (38-pin variant) — not researched, not derived
Green/bold pin labels = pins this project actually uses. SD0-3/CMD/CLK (flash bus, bottom-right) are lower-confidence reads but are not used anywhere in this project.
All grounds (GND) are common on the blue rail.
All 3.3V connections are on the red rail. This board has no separate VIN pin, so
HX711 is also powered from 3.3V here (which is the quieter choice anyway).
DS18B20 needs the 4.7kΩ pull-up between its data line and 3.3V.
GPS: GPIO16 (ESP32 RX) connects to GPS TX; GPIO17 (ESP32 TX) connects to GPS RX —
these must cross. Do not wire RX-to-RX or TX-to-TX.
HX711 board is in hand; the load cell itself and the moisture sensor are on order.
